speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether the Ministry tracks the average and median salaries of early childhood educators according to their educational attainment; and (b) if so, what are the current average and median salaries of early childhood educators according to their educational attainment and how do these compare to five years ago.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Speaker, the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) monitors the salary trends of early childhood educators in a few ways.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: First, ECDA commissions surveys from time to time on salary and other job-related issues in the preschool sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The last survey was conducted two years ago, 2016, and it covered the 79 operators employing close to two-thirds of the educators in the sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Second, the polytechnics collect data on the starting salaries of polytechnic graduates, including those from the early childhood Diploma courses, through their annual Graduate Employment Surveys.
